topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
consensus_response: Both DLB and PNM highlight the advantages of V-band for inter-satellite communication. DLB emphasizes the cost-effectiveness of V-band through reduced satellite count and ground infrastructure, while PNM focuses on the signal strength, reliability, and reduced interference offered by V-band.  While both analyses demonstrate the superiority of V-band for inter-satellite communication, the choice ultimately depends on specific application requirements and trade-offs between cost, performance, and complexity.  V-band offers a compelling solution for many applications, but further analysis and research are needed to address specific challenges and optimize its performance for the future.
